pages.text: Sneak-right-click in the air with a waypoint compass to enter an X and Z coordinate and a name. Right-click normally to read its current location. The needle tracks a saved target in its recorded dimension.
This is BiblioCraft’s waypoint compass. You can also assign a target from a map pin, an atlas waypoint, or a Stockroom Catalog location.

pages.title: Find a Target
pages.text: To reuse a point, click a pin on a map frame with the waypoint compass in hand, or assign a stored compass in the atlas. A compass with no target points toward the world origin.
